preserved: generic SAC checkpoint behavior when no custom saver is installed
98 actor observations with one non-duplicated privileged bundle
20 intermediate IDM-coverage checkpoints and one final Oracle checkpoint

review.scope: fresh review of the complete authorized local repair

source_edits.scope: repair the three formal-audit gaps and their directly exposed owner boundaries

report_write.scope: local module, migration, review, and formal-audit receipts

repository_discipline.rationale: The gateway owns FADA persistence, the runtime owns composition, the runner exposes one generic saver port, the backend exposes public immutable names, and asset hashing occurs only during environment initialization.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: FADAOracleCheckpointGateway owns identity, role schedule, persistence validation, and lineage finalization; scripts/train_offpolicy.py only wires runtime dependencies.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: OffPolicyRuntime adds learner-only kwargs and one optional checkpoint saver port; the default runner path remains unchanged and is regression-tested.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: The environment consumes SimBackend public body and actuator-joint identity methods; no env code reaches into MuJoCo private model fields.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: The writer reloads and validates every saved payload, the reader validates before superclass mutation, and finalization atomically emits the exact 21-record lineage.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: The repair uses one typed runner port and three focused owner modules; it introduces no second runner, checkpoint loop, or script-level policy branch.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: 204 affected tests, 45 off-policy script tests, Ruff, diff checks, module validation, and migration validation establish bounded local engineering facts only.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Canonical identity seals actor/critic/action dimensions, ordered field slices, body names, actuated joint names, XML asset hash, and four resolved-config hashes.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: A real asymmetric replay transaction produces finite actor and critic metrics and changes actor parameters without altering observation ownership.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: A full production checkpoint restores a deliberately mutated actor, while missing or mismatched identity rejects before learner mutation and exact 20+1 finalization succeeds.

residual_risks.description: The bounded local transaction does not execute the production CUDA collector subprocess and pinned-memory transfer lifecycle.
residual_risks.disposition: Carry this as the single LIVE_REQUIRED fact in formal audit before long training.

residual_risks.description: No bounded engineering audit establishes Oracle convergence or locomotion quality.
residual_risks.disposition: Require separately authorized training and post-training policy-quality audit.
